title: From a Tennessee cabin to Nashville’s legacy, Dolly Parton’s dream lives on in a 240-room hotel
summary_full: Following the sad demise of Dolly Parton, Nashville unveiled her final creation, the stunning SongTeller Hotel. Designed to honor her illustrious career, this vibrant hotel features 240 elegantly appointed rooms, alongside two lively music venues and a delightful café. The adjacent Life of Many Colors Museum invites visitors to explore over 300 cherished items and video presentations chronicling Dolly’s extraordinary life journey.
